title: The New Museum Announces Partnership With Vega Foundation
summary: The New Museum has announced a multiyear partnership with the Toronto-based Vega Foundation, an organization dedicated to commissioning and supporting video art. title: Contested Van Gogh Fetches Eye-Watering $190.4 Million at Auction
summary: Vincent van Gogh’s 1890 Châtaigniers en fleurs (Blossoming Chestnut Trees) sold for $190.4 million at Sotheby’s in New York last night, smashing the artist’s auction record and blowing past the $180 million it had been expected to command. title: Sydney Announces Basic Income Program For Artists
summary: The city of Sydney has launched its “artist living grants” program, where 40 artists are given $25,000, about $16,650 USD, no strings attached. The program is based on an income for artists grant that was introduced in Ireland three years ago. It was just made permanent this past winter, giving 2,000 creatives €325 a week. […]

title: Krist Gruijthuijsen Named Director of Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam
summary: The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam has announced Krist Gruijthuijsen as its new director. Gruijthuijsen arrives to the institution from Finland’s EMMA – Espoo Museum of Modern Art, where he has served as director since 2025, and from Kunsthaus Zürich, where he is curator at large. title: Iraq Museum to Reopen After Two Years of Renovations
summary: The Iraq Museum in Baghdad will reopen December 1, as two years of major renovations are completed, according to Ali Al-Dakhili, Iraq’s minister of tourism and antiquities. The space features new galleries for the display of the museum’s extensive collection of antiquities. summary: Art Bridges Foundation has announced that it will give $9.5 million to extend its Access For All Initiative, which has helped 64 museums across the US to offer free admission and community-based programming. summary: The Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago has announced a gift of 65 works of art from Chicago collectors Sandra and Jack Guthman. summary: The Pan-African Biennale (PAB) and the Center for Architecture have announced a joint initiative to launch an open-access digital archive to celebrate architecture from all fifty-four African nations.
